title: The Gardener of Starbreeze

texts.details:
Starbreeze Village fell to the Gnarlpine. We say the furbolgs went mad, and we leave it there.

But the furbolgs were our friends for ten thousand years, $N. Madness is not a thing that simply happens to a people. Someone tends it.

Hunters have seen a satyr on the slope above Starbreeze, east of here. He does not fight beside the Gnarlpine. He sits and watches them, as a gardener watches what he has planted. His kind call him Xalthas the Gentle.

You have heard how they speak. Do not let this one begin.
texts.objectives: Kill Xalthas the Gentle on the slope above Starbreeze Village, then return to Orenthil Whisperwind in Dolanaar.
texts.progress: He will be above the village, where he can see all of it.
texts.completion:
One voice fewer in the dark. The Gnarlpine will not wake from it tomorrow, but no one is whispering to them tonight.

You will meet more of his kind on the mainland. Ashenvale is thick with them. When you do, remember both halves of what you learned here: they were of our blood, and they chose.

Take this, with my thanks.

idea: Chain 2 of 2: a satyr tends the corruption of the Gnarlpine at Starbreeze Village, a place the game asks nothing of.
